label: Toy California network: the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake (M6.9) from USGS ShakeMap
description: The 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake's USGS ShakeMap (117 seismic stations): its median and uncertainty at each bridge, with residuals correlated between bridges (Jayaram & Baker 2009). Pick another event, or a recent one, from the Earthquakes panel. Sampling fetches the map (tens of MB) unless it is cached.

bindings.note: Its period matches the IM below. Swap for independent.any-im to see what the correlation changes.
One system state per non-key node: it survives if it reaches its nearest key destination within the network's target_add_h of the intact time.
